Campaign Supply Chain.explanation: The charity kitchen finds nearby providers via ST_DWithin on provider locations plus the currently-open listings, then sends a supply request carrying the actual need. Providers not in the query can still self-propose, which is why ProviderProposal is attached to ReceiverProfile rather than to a specific request. The provider accepts or rejects an incoming request. Acceptance with transport creates CampaignTransport and Delivery in one transaction and hands the delivery off to DeliveriesService to broadcast to shippers. CampaignTransport is composed by the request, so deleting the request also drops the transport. The kitchen confirms receipt of ingredients with a photo, then opens meal distributions and closes each one with the actual served count. The number is keyed in by the volunteer running the distribution - this campaign flow has NO QR at this stage.
